jobs.title: Data Center Security Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) seeks a Data Center Security Manager (DSM) for our Zurich-area data centers. This role leads physical security operations across multiple sites, reporting directly to the Cluster Security Manager.

Key Aspects Of The Role Include

Managing day-to-day physical security operations
Maintaining site security posture
Overseeing security guard force vendors
Ensuring compliance with AWS security standards

We maintain the foundation of AWS cloud services, ensuring continuous availability of computing resources for our customers worldwide.

The ideal candidate will combine security operations expertise with strong leadership abilities. We offer comprehensive professional development opportunities and the chance to shape the security of one of the world's largest cloud providers.

Key job responsibilities

Responds to Security situations as they arise, based on the direction of the Cluster or Regional Security Manager

Supports the on-site contractor Security team as the primary security contact during the shift and provides guidance based upon existing Physical Security Standards and local SOP’s.
Reports all unusual events to the Cluster Manager in a timely manner.
Provides guidance and direction to the contract security officers to maximize the effectiveness of the Security department.
Oversees access control systems and badge deliveries.
Investigates security events via the alarm and CCTV monitoring system.
Cooperates and coordinates with the Security Operation Center during security incidents or any other security related matter.
Creates and constantly improves procedures, processes and workflows using data and metrics to identify issues and areas of improvements.
Develops specific knowledge of the various operational process paths within the Data Center to identify security vulnerabilities.
Perform various security inspections, audits and investigations as required and as instructed.
Travel to other geographic regions as required

Basic Qualifications

hands on experience in a similar role within the public or private security industry, with demonstrated ability to use data and metrics to improve processes and customer satisfaction.
Strong English verbal and written communication skills with attention to detail and ability to integrate into an international work environment.
Flexibility and availability to be on-call to support out-of-business-hours emergencies both remotely and on-site.
Willingness and ability to travel on company business to Data Centers within the Cluster and abroad.
Valid driving license with eligibility to drive in Switzerland.
3+ years of experience within similar role in the public or private security industry.
3+ of continuous use of Microsoft Outlook, Power Point, Excel and Word.
3+ of experience using data and metrics to improve processes and/or customer satisfaction.
Ability to integrate into an international work environment with a willingness to travel on company business.
Must have the ability to be on-call to support out of business hours emergencies remotely and on-site.
English verbal and written communication skills with attention to details.
Must be prepared and have the ability to work and travel to Data Centers in the Cluster and abroad.
Must have current driving license and be eligible to drive in Switzerland.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using CCTV, access control and intrusion detection systems
Management experience of vendors
Has used investigation techniques to deep dive on events
Strong communication skills
Ability to learn and adapt quickly to company tools for data gathering and analysis
Metrics oriented
Ability to handle pressure and act swiftly and calmly in time of crisis
Ability to handle confidential information with care
Ability to integrate into an international work environment with a willingness to travel on company business.

jobs.title: Material Project Manager – Millennium Space Systems
jobs.description:
Company

Millennium Space Systems

Millennium Space Systems, a part of Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS), is a fast, agile small satellite company focused on national security space. Our missions have direct impact to global security, like missile warning and Earth observation.

Our team is curious, bold and innovative. We take risks, innovate and explore new techniques and technologies. We influence change because we challenge the status quo. And when we watch our satellites launch, we know each one of us made it happen.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Material Project Manager (MPM) which will include, but not limited to, supporting material strategies with the Program Management Office and Manufacturing Organization, maintaining cost and schedule lead times to achieve program success, identifying and mitigating program risks and opportunities and reporting/tracking all program material activities. This is an onsite role in El Segundo, California.

This position's internal job is Business Ops Specialist. Our team is currently hiring for level 3.

Position Responsibilities

Responsible for supporting Control Account Management (CAM) activities associated with material including Baseline schedule & cost planning, providing IMS status, Estimates to Complete (ETC), Estimates At Complete (EAC), variance reporting, and other financial responsibilities
Provide support in identifying material related risks and opportunities and developing mitigation plans
Assist in aggregating all of engineering's material requirements, determining the strategy to procure items while design is matured, and translating it into Material Resource Planning (MRP) requirements
Assisting engineering in design trades to determine make / buy strategies, supplier sourcing, and modifications to material to achieve requirements, cost, and schedule
Perform analysis on material requirements to provide material program summaries that include lines of balance, issue identification, and other metrics relevant to the program scope
Partner with procurement organization to engage with supply base to assess costs, lead times, and strategies to achieve program requirements
Partnering with manufacturing organization to determine how to best ensure all parts are designed for manufacturing to prevent further issues from arising in build process
Execute processes and systems for tracking and reporting material-related metrics, including lead times, lines of balances, and supplier performance
Support continuous improvement initiatives for program and potentially company to enhance material procurement processes, streamline workflows, and optimize supply chain efficiency

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience)

Bachelor’s degree OR equivalent working experience
Minimum of 3 years' experience in material management, procurement, manufacturing or supply chain management
Proficiency in using ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite
Aerospace or Defense experience
This position requires the ability to obtain a US Security Clearance for which the US Government requires US Citizenship. A final U.S. clearance Post Start is required

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)

Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Knowledge of material planning principles and supply chain best practices
Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Ability to lead cross functional teams, foster collaboration, and drive results
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data driven decisions
Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Experience in design development programs preferred
Experience of programs with EVMS requirements
Ability to operate in an ambiguous environment
Must be a self-starter, capable of supporting organizational and program objectives, and able to interface with all levels of internal management as well as supplier management

Conflict Of Interest

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Drug Free Workplace

Millennium Space Systems, a Boeing Company, is a Drug Free Workplace (DFW) where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

Total Rewards

At Millennium Space Systems, a Boeing Company, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

Millennium Space Systems also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary pay range:
Level 3: $101,150 - $148,750

Millennium is DDTC-registered, ITAR-compliant Company. This position is located at a facility that requires special access. Applicants MUST be U.S. citizens and eligible for a security clearance. Additionally, applicants must be willing to apply for and maintain a security clearance. We encourage all interested candidates to apply for any open position for which they feel they are qualified.

Category = Program Integration

Language Requirements

Not Applicable

Education

Not Applicable

Relocation:

Relocation assistance is not a negotiable benefit for this position.

Export Control Requirement

This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R.

120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

Safety Sensitive

This is not a Safety Sensitive Position.

Security Clearance

This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

Visa Sponsorship

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Contingent Upon Award Program

This position is not contingent upon program award

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Business Analyst is the execution partner for CoreVest’s lending technology platforms across origination, underwriting, pricing, and servicing. The Business Analyst owns the detail — translating prioritized initiatives into precise, buildable requirements, well-formed user stories with testable acceptance criteria, and the analysis, documentation, and user acceptance testing that keep delivery moving. This role partners closely with Business Leadership, Sales, Capital Markets, Marketing, Design, Engineering, and Data to translate strategy into scalable, extensible product capabilities that improve speed-to-yes, operational efficiency, and borrower/broker experience.
Responsibilities & Duties

Facilitate discovery and requirement-gathering sessions; distinguish surface-level requests from underlying business needs.
Document complete functional requirements and ensure no negative downstream impacts.
Perform research and analysis on regulations, systems, and business needs; translate findings into actionable product requirements.

User Stories & Backlog Support:
Author clear, independent, testable user stories from the Business and Tehnology prioritized initiatives.
Keep the backlog refined and “ready” ahead of sprint planning, with acceptance criteria defined before development.

Process & Data Analysis
Map current- and future-state workflows across the loan origination and fulfillment lifecycle.
Analyze data and Salesforce configuration so requirements are grounded in how the system actually behaves.

UAT & Sign-off Support
Build and run test scenarios; organize and facilitate user acceptance testing.
Capture defects and feedback; support the Business accept/reject decisions against acceptance criteria.

Documentation & Stakeholder Coordination
Maintain requirements, process documentation, and release/change notes that Operations and Compliance can rely on.
Liaise across Sales, Operations, Capital Markets, and Engineering to gather input and keep stakeholders aligned on what is coming and why.

AI-Native Delivery
Use AI to draft first-pass requirements and user stories, summarize discovery sessions, generate test scenarios, analyze data, and accelerate documentation.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business, or related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
4+ years as a Business Analyst or Salesforce Business Systems Analyst, ideally in financial services or fintech.
Working knowledge of the loan origination and fulfillment lifecycle.
Hands-on Salesforce experience — able to read and understand configuration (objects, flows, validation rules, sharing) well enough to write grounded requirements; SFDC Admin/BSA experience strongly preferred. • Strong requirements craft: user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, and UAT.
Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate between business and engineering.
Demonstrated use of AI tools to accelerate analysis and documentation.

Preferred Experience

Familiarity with lending products such as DSCR, bridge, fix-and-flip, and build-for-rent.
Exposure to Loan Origination Systems (LOS), pricing engines, or underwriting engines.
Understanding of API-driven integrations and how data moves between systems.
Experience in high-growth, regulated lending environments.

What Success Looks Like

Stories arrive at sprint planning ready and unambiguous; rework from unclear requirements is rare.
The Business Product Owner spends time on priorities and outcomes, not chasing requirement detail.
User acceptance testing is organized, traceable, and tied to acceptance criteria.
AI is visibly part of how the Business Analyst produces faster, higher-quality analysis.

A reasonable estimate of the total compensation range for this role is $130,000.00 to $160,000.00. The actual salary offer to the successful candidate will be based on job-related education, geographic location, training, licensure and certification, and other factors. CoreVest also offers a competitive benefit package including discretionary corporate bonus program, multiple health plans, STD and LTD options, company sponsored life insurance, fitness reimbursement, paid parental leave, time to volunteer, Paid Time off, ESPP, and 401K matching.
At Redwood Trust, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued, and everyone has the opportunity thrive. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Finance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

As a Finance Manager supporting the Program Management Office, you will play a crucial role in guiding and overseeing the successful execution of program financials for CAES portfolio. You will be accountable for managing and delivering on complex financial modeling, risk assessments, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, and helping to drive program performance.

You will report directly to the Sr Program Director and you’ll work out of our a San Jose, CA Honeywell CAES Aerospace Technologies location on a 9/80 work schedule.

Responsibilities

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead period-end closing activities across assigned programs, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting between the PMO and Finance organizations
Facilitate weekly and monthly financial cadence across the portfolio, including inputs, reviews, and on-time submission of deliverables to leadership and stakeholders.
Analyze individual program financial performance, including key metrics such as Bookings, Sales, Earnings, and Cash, and provide clear insights to support decision-making.
Monitor elements of cost and program financial health (EAC’s), proactively identifying risks and opportunities and communicating impacts to program and finance leadership.
Support externally reported Earned Value Management (EVM) programs, including compliance with requirements such as IPMDAR, CFSR, DFARS clauses, and DID formats (experience preferred).
Develop and maintain financial dashboards and reporting tools, including stoplight charts, revenue forecasts, cash flow projections, and ROI analyses.
Drive process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and transparency in financial planning, reporting, and controls.
Support investment-related activities, including capital projects, advanced material funding, and proposal development.
Partner cross-functionally with Program Management, Finance, Accounting, and Operations to ensure alignment between financial plans and program execution.
Ensure strong financial controls and compliance with internal policies, external regulations, and audit requirements.

Qualifications

US CITIZEN REQUIREMENT

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual requirements.

YOU MUST HAVE

Experience with financial systems (e.g., SAP) and related financial processes.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, or related field, and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience
Experience supporting Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) processes, systems, and reporting.
Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM)
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams and lead initiatives to successful outcomes.
Strong ability to prioritize, self-manage workload, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to collect, synthesize, and communicate financial information to diverse stakeholders for decision-making.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work both independently and in team environments.
PMP certification or equivalent program management experience is a plus.

Pay Range

The annual base salary range for this position is $161,000 - $200,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

This position is incentive eligible.

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
Employee assistance program and educational assistance
Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

POSTING TIMELINE

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

About Us

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, IR Data Products
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager (TPM) to drive cross-functional planning and execution for our IR Data Product Team. This role will focus on managing the delivery of improvements and new capabilities for the IR Data Product team data processing pipeline. In this role, you will work closely with engineering leaders across software, hardware, science, and product to coordinate efforts from early concept through delivery to (literal!) launch. You will develop schedules and milestones, uncover gaps, flag risks, support resource planning, and ensure clear communication across stakeholders.

As a TPM, you’ll help teams stay aligned, unblock issues quickly, and deliver critical software capabilities that power Muon’s mission. You will provide the structure and process discipline required to scale our development efforts, while enabling teams to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, interdisciplinary environment.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

Program Planning & Roadmapping: Define objectives, scope, milestones, and success criteria in collaboration with engineering and product stakeholders.
Scheduling & Execution Management: Build and maintain project timelines, track dependencies, monitor progress, and adjust plans as priorities shift.
Risk & Issue Management: Identify risks early, coordinate mitigation plans, surface blockers, and drive timely resolution.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate collaboration across software, hardware, science, and product teams, ensuring aligned deliverables and clear handoffs.
Communication & Reporting: Provide concise, actionable updates to stakeholders and leadership on progress, changes, risks, and decisions.
Process & Continuous Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in workflows, propose improvements, and help implement better practices and tools.
Resource & Capacity Planning: Assist in forecasting resource needs, tracking capacity, and supporting prioritization and staffing decisions.
Release Planning & Readiness: Coordinate software releases, track readiness criteria, and communicate expectations to impacted teams.

Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience as a software engineer or in a similar technical role.
3+ years of experience managing or coordinating software development projects.
Demonstrated ability to establish and optimize software project management processes.
Strong technical background managing or implementing teams or projects in cloud computing, data pipeline processing, and/or data science fields.
Strong technical background with knowledge of software development methods, tools, and infrastructure.
Proven ability to communicate effectively with diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience leading cross-functional planning, scheduling, and risk management across multiple teams.
Results-oriented mindset with a bias toward clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Excited to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with evolving priorities.

Nice to have

Experience in aerospace, robotics, logistics, or other domains with real-time high-reliability software development requirements.
Experience reviewing technical documentation, architecture proposals, or requirements specifications.
Comfort with Jira, Confluence and other productivity tools
Exposure to OKR or goal-setting frameworks, and alignment of program priorities with company objectives.
Ability to work effectively in distributed team environments.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $175,000 - $208,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Humanoid Robotics Operations
jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager for Humanoid Robotics Operations!

NVIDIA is seeking a Senior TPM to join the Generalist Embodied Agent Research (GEAR) group. We lead Project GR00T, NVIDIA’s moonshot initiative to build the AI brain for humanoid robots. You will work with an amazing and collaborative research team that consistently produces influential works on LLMs, foundation models, robotics, embodied AI, and physics simulation. Most Project Managers in this market have built their whole career in one lane: commercial or residential, new-build or restoration, rarely all of it at once. At Ultimation Industries, our Project Manager is the primary liaison between our engineering, purchasing, operations, and supplier teams and the customers counting on us to deliver. Ultimation is the largest integrator of Jervis Webb overhead conveyor systems in the U.S. and a fast-growing leader in automation for automotive, e-commerce, and industrial markets. Manage stakeholder expectations proactively and resolve conflicts before they impact delivery.

Project Manager – Communications

Dallas, TX /West Texas (Field-Based)

Join a team focused on delivering complex healthcare equipment installation projects that support customer operations across the healthcare continuum. As a Project Manager
, you will lead projects from planning through completion, coordinating resources, managing schedules and budgets, and partnering with customers and internal teams to ensure projects are executed according to scope, timeline, and quality requirements.

Candidates must be located within commuting distance of Dallas-FT Worth or Lubbock, TX, as this role provides on-site support across the DFW and West Texas region and spends approximately 60% of the time in the field.

To learn more about Stryker’s Communication Business Unit portfolio, click here: https://www.stryker.com/us/en/communications.html

What You Will Do

Lead complex healthcare equipment installation projects from project charter development through final project completion.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, forecasts, and work breakdown structures to manage scope, timelines, and deliverables.
Monitor project execution, evaluate project tradeoffs, and communicate schedule adjustments resulting from product, installation, or customer-driven changes.
Manage project budgets, track costs against approved plans, and support budget forecasting throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify project risks, develop risk mitigation plans, and coordinate internal and external resources to address issues impacting project delivery.
Facilitate customer kickoff meetings and provide ongoing project updates to customers, vendors, engineering teams, sales partners, and other stakeholders.
Coordinate installation scoping activities, engineering reviews, documentation management, and project readiness requirements to support successful installations.
Assign project actions, track stakeholder accountability, and mentor Associate Project Managers and less-tenured Project Managers through project planning and execution activities.
Ability to support On-site management during installations, including wearing full personal protective equipment (PPE).

Required Qualifications

What You Will Need

Minimum 4 years of project management experience.
Bachelor’s degree; OR Associate’s degree with minimum 4 years of relevant work experience; OR high school diploma with minimum 6 years of relevant work experience.
Experience managing project schedules, budgets, scope, and risk throughout the project lifecycle.
Experience coordinating activities across multiple stakeholder groups, including customers, vendors, and internal business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within healthcare, medical device, healthcare technology, construction, engineering, or related industries.
Experience in construction processes, construction schedules, trade coordination, site readiness requirements, facility renovation activities, or construction project coordination.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management certification.
Experience managing large-volume and complex capital installation projects.

Job Title:
Project Manager I - Data Center Construction

Location:
Waukesha, WI (Regional travel may be required based on project needs)

Company:
The Boldt Company

Anticipated Salary Range:
$130,000 - $175,000

Position Overview

At The Boldt Company, we build more than buildings—we build strong teams, trusted client relationships, and careers with purpose. We’re seeking an experienced Project Manager II who thrives in a collaborative, jobsite‑based environment and enjoys leading work from the ground up.

In this role, you’ll manage mission critical construction
projects from preconstruction through closeout, typically ranging from $100M–$800M, while working side‑by‑side with Superintendents and project management teams on site. You’ll own planning, schedules, budgets, and client communication, using modern construction technology to drive smart decisions and keep projects on track. You will be responsible for protecting uptime, mitigating risk, and delivering zero-defect turnover, while maintaining alignment with Boldt’s safety culture, schedule commitments, and financial performance. You will lead cross-functional teams and serve as a key interface with clients, many of whom operate in 24/7 in zero-downtime environments. This is a great opportunity for a project leader who values teamwork, accountability, and seeing their impact firsthand—every day, in the field.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $124,000 - $166,000 annually. This information reflects the anticipated base salary for this position based on current market data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual’s skills, experiences, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Why We Exist

Our People: We create opportunities for growth, fulfillment, and reaching full potential.
Our Partners: We collaborate with trust and respect to drive innovation and shared success.
Our Customers: We exceed expectations through advocacy, problem‑solving, and collaboration.
Our Communities: We give back with our time, talents, and resources—elevating dignity and doing good.

Why You’ll Love Working at Boldt

100% Employee‑Owned – Your work directly drives company success and your long‑term growth through our ESOP.
Purpose‑Driven (ESG) – We deliver positive impact for people, the environment, and performance—aligned with our core values.
Better Together – Strong teamwork, open communication, and shared accountability from the field to the office.
Safety First – An industry safety leader whose goal is getting everyone home safe every day is non‑negotiable.
Grow Your Career – Real opportunities to advance while working with experienced, collaborative teams.
High‑Impact Work – Tackle complex industrial projects that challenge you and make a difference.
Lead & Mentor – Develop the next generation of project engineers and project managers.
Rich Culture: What started as a carpentry shop has grown into a multi‑million‑dollar company built on relationships and craftsmanship
High Performance: By people, strengthened through AI and technology that enhance collaboration, transparency, and results.

What You Bring

Four-year engineering or construction management degree. Combination of education and or industry experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
Seven plus years of construction experience, with 5 plus years of mission critical construction projects focusing on strong coordination and execution.
Working knowledge of MEP systems and integrated building systems is preferred.
Proven ability to manage schedules, budgets, and project financials with confidence and accountability.
Strong knowledge of construction means and methods and how they translate from plan to field.
Clear and effective communicator who can collaborate with craft professionals, project leadership, and clients.

Nice to Have

Basic experience with data center commissioning processes (Level 1–5).
Ability to work in dynamic and fluid environments with operational constraints and change control requirements.
Strong focus on documentation rigor, QA/QC, and turnover excellence.

Unsolicited Correspondence

The Boldt Group and its subsidiaries engage recruiting agencies exclusively through our Enterprise Support Talent Acquisition team and only when a valid, Boldt‑approved agreement is in place. Boldt does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions at any time, including from agencies with an active agreement—unless the submission is expressly requested by the Enterprise Support Talent Acquisition team.

Any unsolicited submissions will be deemed the property of The Boldt Group, and no placement fees will be paid. All agency inquiries must be directed to the Enterprise Support Talent Acquisition team. At this time, we are not entertaining any new agency submissions or outreach.

jobs.title: FTZ Program Manager
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The FTZ Program Manager leads the continuous improvement, compliance, and long-term effectiveness of Rockwell Automation's Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) program. You will provide strategic oversight of FTZ operations across North America, with a focus on regulatory compliance, external partnership management, audit readiness, program optimization and longterm effectiveness of the program. You will work with company partners, Managed Service Providers, software vendors, and regulatory bodies to ensure FTZ operations are compliant, efficient, scalable, and aligned with our goals. You will be an important liaison with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), FTZ Boards, grantees, and external auditors, while driving sustainable improvements to processes, and governance. You will report to the Trade Compliance Manager for North America and you will be remote.

Your Responsibilities

Lead the FTZ continuous improvement agenda, driving enhancements to compliance quality, process efficiency, system stability, and cost avoidance.
Implement improvement projects based on regulatory changes, audit findings, health checks, and business growth.
Oversee develop, implement, and maintenance standardized FTZ processes, procedures, controls, manuals, and governance frameworks.
Measure FTZ performance metrics, risks, and recommended improvements to leadership.
Provide subject matter leadership on FTZ regulatory requirements, including 19 CFR, 15 CFR, and CBP guidance.
Ensure ongoing compliance with FTZ regulations and proactive identification and mitigation of compliance risks.
Oversee annual systems reviews, reconciliations, and regulatory filings, including preparation of required reports to CBP and zone grantees.
Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting FTZs and ensure communication and implementation.
Lead internal and external FTZ audits, CBP compliance reviews, and independent compliance health checks.
Be the primary contact for regulators, auditors, and external reviewers.
Oversee corrective action plans, validate remediation effectiveness, and ensure sustainable resolution of findings.
Support investigations and compliance assessments, making recommendations for program improvements.
Manage strategic relationships with FTZ Managed Service Providers, software providers, consultants, and advisors.
Oversee thirdparty FTZ performance to ensure service quality, compliance, and agreement on Rockwell Automation expectations.
Partner crossfunctionally with Trade Compliance, Logistics, Finance, IT, Operations, Legal, and Departments on FTZrelated programs.
Support business projects including new zone implementations, expansions, product moves, and distribution strategy changes.
Be the FTZ program ambassador by providing training, guidance, and awareness to company partners.
Prepare and deliver clear, executivelevel communications and presentations related to FTZ compliance and program performance.

The Essentials - You Will Have

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Years of Relevant Work Experience.
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
The ability to travel 10% of the time.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

10+ years of experience in Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) programs or U.S. trade compliance.
Demonstrated experience working with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), FTZ Boards, and zone grantees.
Experience managing thirdparty service providers or Managed Service Providers.
Experience with FTZ inventory control and recordkeeping systems.
Experience leading continuous improvement projects and managing compliance programs.
Experience leading external audits, CBP compliance reviews, and compliance health checks.
Project management experience supporting complex, crossfunctional projects.
Knowledge of import/export regulations, international transportation, and supply chain operations.
Experience with CTPAT or other trade security programs.
Licensed U.S. Customs Broker.

What We Offer

Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
401k
Paid Time off
Parental and Caregiver Leave
Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.

The company provides innovative identity and risk solutions, empowering institutions and individuals to transact with confidence. The organization is building the future of identity verification, replacing a clunky, ineffective, and expensive status quo with solutions that are faster, smarter, and more accurate.

The company has seen tremendous traction and is growing extremely quickly. Its real-time APIs have helped verify hundreds of millions of identities, starting with financial services and rapidly expanding into new markets. The organization is backed by world-class investors.

The company has earned recognition from various publications and has been named to prestigious lists. It has also made history by being the first company to go live with a key industry standard and testified before a government committee on the future of identity.

The company supports a variety of ways to work, ranging from fully remote to in-office. It operates as a digital-first organization with strong collaboration across different regions. The company maintains physical offices in several U.S. cities and in India. Depending on the role and location, there may be an expectation to spend time in the office regularly. to build and scale learning initiatives.

The role will own learning across the employee lifecycle - from onboarding and fraud education through to manager development, leadership capability, performance enablement, and knowledge sharing. Some programs already exist; many do not. The individual will be expected to identify where learning can have the biggest impact, design practical solutions, and deliver them.
This role reports to the Head of People and partners closely with leaders across the company.

Develop and own the organization's learning and development strategy, identifying capability gaps and prioritizing learning initiatives that have measurable business impact.

Act as the primary owner for learning and development within the organization, balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution.

Curious, collaborative, pragmatic, and highly execution-oriented.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving SaaS environment, is comfortable navigating technical complexity and ambiguity, and uses AI and automation to make project execution more efficient and scalable.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
jobs.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.

How You Will Impact Skylo

You will own end-to-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the packet core
, the signalling plane
, and billing & settlement
. You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on-time technical delivery.

This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.v

What You'll Do

wn the MNO technical onboarding program end-to-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP-over-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS-over-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
Coordinate billing & settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
Program-manage the multi-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel-run and rollback planning, and de-risking the transition away from single-supplier dependency.
Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross-functional launch-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.

Sound like you? You bring:

You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.

8+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands-on time in the signalling plane
Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy & topology
A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).

NB-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
Hands-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per-partner signalling readiness.
Working understanding of billing & settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57), RAP (TD.32), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
Demonstrated track record shipping cross-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.
Credible in a signalling design review and in a partner integration call alike — equally at home with core engineers and external carrier counterparts.Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of picking up new ones quickly.

It Would Be Great If You Had Experience With

NTN, NB-IoT, or cellular IoT connectivity experience.
SMS-over-NAS delivery paths (SGd Diameter and MAP-via-IPX), and CIoT optimizations (NIDD, control-plane CIoT).
Experience with wholesale roaming, MVNO/MVNE, or roaming-hub environments.
Familiarity with BCE and next-generation settlement, and with ERP/finance-system integration for billing.
Exposure to clearing-house and IPX supplier commercial/technical management.

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)

A single, trusted onboarding program that partner-facing and engineering teams both plan against — with cycle time trending down as volume grows.
Signalling and billing readiness treated as a gated part of every partner launch, not a post-launch surprise.
The multi-supplier roaming transition de-risked with a clear cutover and rollback plan, and no single-supplier lock-in surprises.
Program-level visibility into signalling and settlement health that leadership actually uses to make calls.

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:

Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
Comprehensive benefits plan
Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Meet the Team

You will join a team building complex, cloud-native SaaS and AI-powered products that move from concept through production launch, adoption, and ongoing operation. The team works across product management, engineering, applied AI/ML, data, infrastructure, security, compliance, customer experience, and go-to-market partners to deliver customer-ready capabilities at scale. This is a highly multi-functional environment where transparency, execution, rigor, and strong partnership are critical to success. The work is fast-moving, and focused on delivering enterprise-grade products and AI capabilities that are reliable, secure, and built for real-world adoption.

Your Impact

As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead sophisticated SaaS and AI-powered product initiatives from strategy through production delivery and operation. You will bring structure to ambiguous programs and drive alignment across large, multi-functional teams.

Turn product and technical strategy into clear plans, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and ownership across teams.
Lead large programs with moderate to high risk, multiple interdependencies, and impact across customers, partners, platforms, and releases.
Lead programs spanning product, engineering, design, data, applied AI/ML, infrastructure, security, compliance, customer experience, and go-to-market teams.
Influence product and technical roadmaps by managing critical paths, sequencing, architecture dependencies, delivery tradeoffs, risks, resources, and commitments.
Lead agentic AI programs from definition through production and iteration, coordinating agent workflows, model and tool integration, grounding, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and human oversight.
Establish evaluation-driven delivery practices so AI quality, safety, latency, cost, and reliability are measured before launch and monitored in production.
Partner with engineering and quality teams to define validation, release, observability, and operational-readiness requirements for continuous integration and deployment.
Communicate program status, technical tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to executive audiences with clear recommendations.
Provide guidance and mentorship to other program managers and team members while driving a strategic horizon of one year or more.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 6+ years of related experience, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
Experience leading complex technical programs for enterprise SaaS products through production launch and ongoing operation.
Experience directly leading at least one generative AI, LLM-based, or agentic capability through development, production launch, and post-launch iteration.
Previous experience leading cross-functional technical programs through influence in a highly matrixed organization.
Experience in cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, data systems, and modern AI development and deployment practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading multi-team SaaS or AI programs involving cloud-native architecture, API integrations, data platforms, AI evaluations, security, reliability, and customer-facing production launches.
Experience with generative AI and agentic systems, including agent orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Ability to understand system architecture, identify cross-platform dependencies, facilitate engineering tradeoffs, and translate complex technical risks and decisions for executive audiences.
Experience applying fit-for-purpose development and execution practices, including Agile methodologies, to improve planning, decision-making, delivery, and learning.
Strong ability to bring structure to ambiguous initiatives, drive timely decisions, and create accountability across product, engineering, security, compliance, customer experience, and go-to-market stakeholders.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

This role is based in Nashville, TN. This role will require relocation to Nashville, TN if you do not reside in the region.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished Lead Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) and Server Operations programs across parts of North America.

This Lead Principal TPM will provide strategic and operational program leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix support, and automation across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish scalable program mechanisms that enable rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, workforce effectiveness, and technical rigor. This leader will partner across engineering and operations teams, standardize execution across multiple sites, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and data-driven program management.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions while improving the systems, tools, and operating rhythms that support reliable cloud infrastructure at scale.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and technically strong program leader with a proven track record of driving large-scale infrastructure, cloud operations, and automation programs through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations execution across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide program leadership for Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations initiatives across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix operations, and operational automation.
Develop and execute scalable program frameworks capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple sites and cross-functional teams.
Lead complex, geographically distributed programs that improve operational performance, safety, security, availability, and service quality across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.
Drive operational excellence by standardizing deployment methodologies, improving service delivery, strengthening program governance, and implementing best practices across regional operations.
Champion the use of AI, automation, scripting, process engineering, and data-driven decision making to improve productivity, increase operational efficiency, and reduce the dependency between infrastructure growth and manual effort.
Partner closely with Engineering, Networking, Software Development, Product, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, and other cross-functional organizations to ensure successful delivery of new cloud regions and ongoing operational excellence.
Ensure customer commitments and operational service levels are consistently achieved while proactively managing program risk, dependencies, and execution gaps.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Senior technical program management experience within hyperscale cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, hardware support, data center operations, software development, or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience driving large, geographically distributed programs across multiple teams, sites, and operational functions.
Demonstrated success scaling operational systems, program mechanisms, and execution models within rapidly growing cloud or technology organizations.
Strong understanding of hyperscale data center operations, distributed systems, infrastructure deployment, hardware lifecycle management, networking, storage, compute, and operational support.
Proven track record of driving operational transformation through AI, automation, intelligent tooling, scripting, process engineering, and scalable program models.
Experience leveraging emerging AI capabilities, operational analytics, Jira, Confluence, and related program tooling to improve workforce productivity, operational performance, and service quality.
Exceptional strategic thinking, technical judgment, program execution, and written and verbal communication.
Strong executive presence with the ability to present complex information clearly and influence senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, product, and business organizations.
Experience partnering with engineering and operations teams in collaborative, agile environments while driving clarity, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

Leadership Competencies

Performance, drive, and execution—Holds self and others accountable for delivering shareholder value. Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Takes full accountability for the achievement of organizational results. Delivers audience-appropriate messages about financial performance and future expectations.
Collaboration—Fosters collaboration between business leaders. Facilitates consensus among diverse stakeholders with opposing viewpoints on critical issues. Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.
Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.
Competitive edge—Predicts changes in customer expectations; takes advantage of opportunities to shape and re-shape market propositions. Builds long-term business value. Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.
Change agility—Initiates strategic change initiatives in anticipation of a changing external environment. Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Fosters creativity, measured risk-taking actions, and entrepreneurial thinking in others
Mastering complexity—Makes decisions about the long-term strategy to sustainably grow the business. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. Actively supports the resolution of ambiguous, complex problems that cross organizational boundaries. Creates an environment of personal accountability and ownership for problem-solving.

Education

A Bachelors’ degree is preferred. An advanced degree is a plus.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager 

Full Time + Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k with Company Match, PTO)

Job Type: Onsite

Salary  
Range: $120,000 - $140,000, DOE

Shift: Day

Location: Poway, CA 

Fralock is an engineered solutions provider of specialty components and subassemblies using advanced materials for high reliability, severe environment, and technically challenging applications. We develop and manufacture custom integrated solutions. Established in 1967, we are a critical solutions provider to Fortune 500 corporations, government, and targeted OEMs in a variety of industries including Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing, Medical and Life Science, Aerospace and Defense, Industrial, Electronics, and Energy. Fralock is headquartered in Valencia, CA with manufacturing locations located throughout Northern and Southern California.

VISION

To be recognized by our customers as a leading solutions provider of proprietary engineered advanced materials for high reliability, severe environment, and technically challenging applications.

MISSION

To create value, profitably grow, and share our success with all stakeholders.

CULTURE

Respect – We treat others the way they want to be treated.

Integrity – We practice a high standard of ethics in our business dealings with customers, suppliers and employees.

Responsiveness – We have a sense of urgency in responding to internal and external requests and work proactively to solve problems.

Excellence/Competence – We empower our people to continuously improve and execute high quality work. 

Teamwork – We work together to achieve Fralock business objectives by communicating at a high level, by listening and having clarity in our expectations of one another. 

Individual Accountability and Personal Responsibility – We do what we have committed to do when we committed to doing it. 

Continuous Improvement across all segments of the company

This position requires access to information controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the successful candidate must be a "U.S. person" as defined in the ITAR and EAR (which generally means (i) be a citizen or national of the United States; or (ii) be a lawful permanent resident of the United States; or (iii) have been admitted to the United States as a refugee, or have been granted asylum, as specified under applicable law.

Main Functions

The Project Manager is responsible for leading customer programs and internal cross-functional projects from initiation through completion, ensuring that scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and customer expectations are clearly defined, actively managed, and successfully delivered. This role serves as the primary coordination point across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and Customer Service to ensure Fralock executes with discipline, urgency, and accountability.

The successful candidate will help strengthen program execution, improve communication, identify risks early, drive timely issue resolution, and support Fralock’s commitment to reliable delivery, customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities 

Lead assigned customer programs, new product introductions, transfers, qualifications, production ramps, and strategic internal projects from launch through completion.

Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, action registers, risk logs, and communication cadences.

Coordinate cross-functional activity across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution.

Serve as the central point of contact for project status, open actions, risks, customer commitments, and escalation needs.

Drive accountability by assigning owners, due dates, deliverables, and follow-up actions, ensuring commitments are completed on time.

Monitor project scope, timing, cost, resources, capacity constraints, quality requirements, and customer deliverables.

Identify risks and issues early, escalate appropriately, and facilitate problem-solving to remove roadblocks and protect customer commitments.

Support quote-to-launch and prototype-to-production activities, including engineering reviews, qualification planning, manufacturability input, material readiness, and production handoff.

Prepare and communicate project updates, dashboards, meeting notes, leadership summaries, and customer-facing status reports as needed.

Partner with Sales and Strategic Account teams to support customer communication, business reviews, site visits, escalation meetings, and program-level alignment.

Work with Operations and Supply Chain to understand capacity, material availability, lead times, production readiness, and delivery risks.

Support continuous improvement of project management tools, processes, templates, reporting routines, and governance standards.

Use ERP, CRM, Microsoft Office, and other business systems to maintain accurate project information and support data-driven decisions.

Balance customer advocacy with Fralock’s operational capabilities, profitability requirements, quality standards, and business priorities.

Follow all safety requirements and company policies.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Skills

Strong project management, organization, prioritization, and follow-through skills.

Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive completion of actions through influence and accountability.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with customers, leadership, technical teams, and production personnel.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.

Ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deliverables in a manufacturing environment.

Working knowledge of manufacturing operations, engineering change processes, quality requirements, supply chain coordination, and production planning.

Experience identifying project risks, developing mitigation plans, and escalating issues appropriately.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.

Experience with ERP, MRP, CRM, or project management systems preferred.

Ability to interpret technical drawings, customer requirements, specifications, and project documentation preferred.

Experience in aerospace and defense, semiconductor, medical device, electronics, advanced materials, or high-reliability manufacturing preferred.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Project Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.

Experience Requirements

Minimum of 5 years of project management, program management, operations, engineering, customer program, or related experience in a manufacturing or technical environment preferred.

Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, APQP, or similar certification preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

Frequent use of hands for computer work, documentation, and communication tools.

Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move throughout office and production areas as needed.

Ability to perform similar operations and tasks for extended periods.

Program Manager - Products & Services Privacy

Job Summary

This role is responsible for leading and managing privacy projects and enable the HP Products & Services organizations in meeting global privacy, data protection, AI governance, and regulatory compliance obligations. The Program Manager serves as the operational backbone of the privacy organization, driving program execution, portfolio management, stakeholder engagement, project governance, reporting, and continuous process improvement.

The role partners closely with Privacy Advisors, Legal, Engineering, Product Management, Security, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to ensure privacy initiatives are prioritized, tracked, communicated, and delivered effectively. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in program management, cross-functional coordination, executive reporting, operational excellence, and organizational change management.

Success in this role requires balancing multiple initiatives, driving accountability across stakeholders, identifying and mitigating risks, and ensuring leadership has visibility into program health, compliance readiness, and strategic priorities.

Responsibilities

Program & Portfolio Management

Lead the planning, execution, and governance of privacy and compliance programs across HP Products & Services initiatives.
Manage a portfolio of privacy initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, resource availability, and regulatory commitments.
Develop and maintain program roadmaps, project plans, milestones, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
Establish and drive project governance structures, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
Ensure initiatives progress according to established timelines and proactively address obstacles, risks, and resource constraints.
Coordinate activities across multiple workstreams, teams, and business units to ensure successful execution.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communications

Build strong relationships with business leaders and operational teams to facilitate collaboration and program success.
Drive stakeholder alignment on priorities, timelines, deliverables, and decision-making processes.
Prepare executive-level presentations, status reports, dashboards, and briefing materials for leadership reviews.
Facilitate governance meetings, steering committees, project reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
Communicate program progress, key risks, dependencies, and escalations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
Manage stakeholder expectations and drive accountability for commitments and action items.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

Develop and maintain project tracking systems, intake processes, workflow management tools, and operational dashboards.
Identify opportunities to streamline privacy operations through standardization, automation, and process improvements.
Create and maintain program documentation, procedures, playbooks, templates, and operating guides.
Establish consistent methodologies for project intake, prioritization, status reporting, and resource management.

Risk Management & Compliance Coordination

Identify, assess, monitor, and communicate program risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
Track regulatory-driven commitments and compliance initiatives to ensure timely execution and reporting.

This individual will work closely with government collaborators, operational users, engineering teams, and mission partners to ensure sustained delivery of critical capabilities that support national security objectives. The Senior Sustainment Program Manager will routinely engage with Government program offices, operational users, prime contractors, and mission partners to ensure alignment of sustainment activities, operational priorities, modernization initiatives, and contractual requirements. Ensure alignment between prime contract objectives, subcontract deliverables, and mission sustainment requirements.

Manage program cost, schedule, technical performance, and EVMS reporting.

Demonstrated experience working directly with DoD customers as well as large defense prime contractors in a program execution, sustainment, or lifecycle management role

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
